notes.title: Haru to Shura ver.1.00.6 update announcement
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed.
-When entering the hospital just before delivering the scarf, if you moved in the opposite direction, the screen would stay dark.

The following has been added
-Prompts you to save just before the story branches with an important choice.
-A system message is displayed when the pocket is full.

The above has been fixed.
Please update to the latest version before playing.

Thank you for your support by purchasing and playing "Haru to Shura", reviewing it, reporting bugs, helping us identify bugs, following us on Twitter and RT.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Haru to Shura ver.1.00.4 update announcement
notes.content:
Fixed:
-The game stops progressing after you get the acroons in the tomb.
-Chihiro is lying down and has his foot on Yoru's knee.

The above has been fixed.
Before playing, please update to version 1.00.4.
If it doesn't update, please try logging out again.

*If you start from the save data right before the event where you get the acroons at the tomb, you will need to insert another scene right before the event in order to examine the tomb and get the acroons.

We would like to thank everyone who has purchased and played "Haru to Shura", reviewed it, reported bugs, helped us identify bugs, followed us on Twitter, and RT'd us.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Haru to Shura ver.1.00.3 update announcement
notes.content:
Fixed:
-Game progress stops after examining the diary.
-Game progress stops after getting leftover bread from the bar
-Hints are not displayed correctly when sitting on the couch.
-Some Japanese text is displayed in English.
-English typos

The above has been fixed.
Please update your game before playing.
If it doesn't update, please try logging out again.

We would like to thank everyone who has purchased and played "Haru to Shura", reviewed it, reported bugs, helped us identify bugs, followed us on Twitter, and RT'd us.
